questions.question: Which company had the highest revenue in fiscal 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 AND NOT revenue IS NULL ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Apple's revenue in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT revenue FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'AAPL' AND fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was Microsoft's net income in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT net_income FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'MSFT' AND fiscal_year = 2022

questions.question: Which company had the highest operating margin in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT r.ticker FROM ratios AS r WHERE r.fiscal_year = 2023 AND NOT r.operating_margin IS NULL ORDER BY r.operating_margin DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which company had the highest net margin in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT r.ticker FROM ratios AS r JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE r.fiscal_year = 2024 AND NOT r.net_margin IS NULL ORDER BY r.net_margin DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which sector had the highest average net margin in 2023?
questions.sql: WITH sector_avg AS (SELECT c.sector, AVG(r.net_margin) AS avg_net_margin FROM companies AS c JOIN ratios AS r USING (ticker) WHERE r.fiscal_year = 2023 GROUP BY c.sector) SELECT sector FROM sector_avg ORDER BY avg_net_margin DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many companies had revenue above 100 billion dollars in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.ticker) AS company_count FROM financials AS f JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2023 AND f.revenue > 100000000000

questions.question: Which company had the largest total assets in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT c.ticker FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2024 AND f.total_assets = (SELECT MAX(total_assets) FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2024) ORDER BY c.ticker

questions.question: Which company had the smallest total assets in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT c.ticker FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE f.fiscal_year = 2023 AND NOT f.total_assets IS NULL ORDER BY f.total_assets ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which company generated the most operating cash flow in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 AND NOT operating_cash_flow IS NULL ORDER BY operating_cash_flow DESC, ticker LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Apple's revenue growth from 2023 to 2024, in percent?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND((f24.revenue / f23.revenue - 1) * 100, 1) AS revenue_growth_percent FROM financials AS f23 JOIN financials AS f24 USING (ticker) WHERE f23.ticker = 'AAPL' AND f23.fiscal_year = 2023 AND f24.fiscal_year = 2024

questions.question: Which company had the highest revenue growth from 2022 to 2023, in percent?
questions.sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT ticker, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2022 THEN revenue END) AS rev_2022, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2023 THEN revenue END) AS rev_2023 FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year IN (2022, 2023) GROUP BY ticker HAVING NOT rev_2022 IS NULL AND NOT rev_2023 IS NULL), growth AS (SELECT ticker, (rev_2023 / rev_2022 - 1) * 100.0 AS pct_growth FROM rev) SELECT ticker FROM growth WHERE pct_growth = (SELECT MAX(pct_growth) FROM growth) ORDER BY ticker

questions.question: Which companies had lower net income in 2023 than in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.ticker FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f2023 USING (ticker) JOIN financials AS f2022 USING (ticker) WHERE f2023.fiscal_year = 2023 AND f2022.fiscal_year = 2022 AND f2023.net_income < f2022.net_income ORDER BY c.ticker

questions.question: What was the total revenue of the Technology sector in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE c.sector = 'Technology' AND f.fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was the average revenue of Healthcare companies in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(f.revenue) AS average_revenue FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE c.sector = 'Healthcare' AND f.fiscal_year = 2022

questions.question: Which companies have no operating income values in this dataset?
What was Johnson & Johnson's pretax margin in 2023, in percent?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(f.pretax_income / f.revenue * 100, 1) FROM companies AS c JOIN financials AS f USING (ticker) WHERE c.name = 'Johnson & Johnson' AND f.fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was Coca-Cola's ratio of operating cash flow to net income in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(operating_cash_flow / net_income, 2) AS operating_cash_flow_to_net_income FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'KO' AND fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: Which company had the highest net income in 2021?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2021 AND NOT net_income IS NULL ORDER BY net_income DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many fiscal years of data do we have for Walmart?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year_count FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'WMT'
